description.content:
Retrieve a paginated list of all audit logs for the tenant.

String filters behave differently per field:
- `resource_name` and `sub_object_name` perform case-insensitive partial matching
  (SQL `ILIKE '%value%'`) when given a plain string. To force an exact match,
  use the object form `filter[<field>][type]=match&filter[<field>][value]=<value>`.
- All other string filters (IDs, enums) remain exact match.

Export all audit logs for the tenant as a CSV file.

The CSV includes all audit log fields (see the AuditLog schema for field definitions):
- name, user_id, action_id, use_case_id, team_id
- resource_type, resource_id, resource_name
- sub_object_type, sub_object_id, sub_object_name
- user (object with id, email, name, role)
- action (object with id, type, data)
- metadata (event-specific data)
- inserted_at, message

You can optionally filter which columns to include using the `columns` parameter.

query.description: Comma-separated list of column names to include in the export (e.g., 'name,user_id,resource_type,inserted_at')

The tenant identifier

The Credo AI API provides endpoints for managing AI models, use cases, and policy controls.

## Authentication
All API requests must include a valid Bearer token in the Authorization header.
To obtain a token, use the [`POST /auth/exchange`](#tag/Auth/operation/CredoAIWeb.Auth.TokenController.exchange) endpoint with your API token and tenant.

## Rate Limiting
API requests are limited based on your subscription plan. Contact support for specific limits.

## Versioning
This is version 2.0 of the API. All endpoints are prefixed with `/api/v2/`.
